```yaml
name: Nightly CI & Security Gates

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at 02:00 UTC every day
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_full_suite:
        description: 'Run full 17-gate suite'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      run_security_scan:
        description: 'Run security vulnerability scan'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  checks: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  cancel-previous:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

  unit-tests:
    name: Go Unit Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Run Go Tests
        run: |
          go test -v -coverprofile=coverage.out ./core/... ./...

      - name: Upload Coverage
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.out

  security-scan:
    name: Security Vulnerability Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit-tests
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_security_scan == true || github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Trivy vulnerability scanner
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: 'fs'
          format: 'sarif'
          output: 'trivy-results.sarif'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'

      - name: Upload Trivy scan results to GitHub Security tab
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        if: always()
        with:
          sarif_file: 'trivy-results.sarif'

  production-gates:
    name: Production Gates (17)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: unit-tests
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        gate:
          # Core Identity & Access
          - name: "Gate 1: RBAC Fail-Closed"
            script: "go test -v ./core/auth/... -run TestRequireRoleFailClosed"
          - name: "Gate 2: Key Revocation Integrity"
            script: "go test -v ./core/crypto/... -run TestKeyRevocationLuaFix"
          - name: "Gate 3: Identity Lifecycle"
            script: "go test -v ./core/identity/... -run TestIdentityLifecycle"
          - name: "Gate 4: Access Control Enforcement"
            script: "go test -v ./core/access/... -run TestAccessEnforcement"
          
          # Data & Streaming
          - name: "Gate 5: Data Lifecycle Management"
            script: "go test -v ./core/data/... -run TestDataLifecycle"
          - name: "Gate 6: Streaming Stability"
            script: "go test -v ./core/stream/... -run TestStreamingStability"
          - name: "Gate 7: Advanced Workflows"
            script: "go test -v ./core/workflow/... -run TestAdvancedWorkflows"
          
          # Configuration & Policy
          - name: "Gate 8: Config Hierarchy Resolution"
            script: "go test -v ./core/config/... -run TestConfigHierarchy"
          - name: "Gate 9: Policy Lifecycle"
            script: "go test -v ./core/policy/... -run TestPolicyLifecycle"
          
          # Infrastructure & Management
          - name: "Gate 10: Pack Management"
            script: "go test -v ./core/pack/... -run TestPackManagement"
          - name: "Gate 11: Degradation Mode"
            script: "go test -v ./core/resilience/... -run TestDegradationMode"
          - name: "Gate 12: Dashboard Integration"
            script: "go test -v ./core/dashboard/... -run TestDashboardIntegration"
          
          # Integration & End-to-End (Docker Compose)
          - name: "Gate 13: E2E Auth Flow"
            script: "docker compose up -d && go test -v ./e2e/... -run TestAuthFlow"
          - name: "Gate 14: E2E Data Ingestion"
            script: "docker compose up -d && go test -v ./e2e/... -run TestDataIngestion"
          - name: "Gate 15: E2E Revocation Propagation"
            script: "docker compose up -d && go test -v ./e2e/... -run TestRevocationPropagation"
          - name: "Gate 16: E2E Config Reload"
            script: "docker compose up -d && go test -v ./e2e/... -run TestConfigReload"
          - name: "Gate 17: E2E Dashboard Health"
            script: "docker compose up -d && go test -v ./e2e/... -run TestDashboardHealth"

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Run Gate ${{ matrix.gate.name }}
        run: |
          echo "Running ${{ matrix.gate.name }}"
          ${{ matrix.gate.script }}

      - name: Cleanup Docker Resources
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker compose down -v --remove-orphans || true

  test-summary:
    name: Generate Test Summary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [unit-tests, production-gates]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Download Coverage
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report

      - name: Generate Test Summary
        uses: test-summary/action@v2
        with:
          paths: "coverage.out"
          output: test-summary.md

      - name: Upload Test Summary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-summary
          path: test-summary.md

  notify:
    name: Notify Slack
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [unit-tests, security-scan, production-gates]
    if: always() && (needs.unit-tests.result == 'failure' || needs.production-gates.result == 'failure' || needs.security-scan.result == 'failure')
    steps:
      - name: Notify Slack on Failure
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          channel: '#devops-alerts'
          message: "Nightly CI failed for cordum-io/cordum. Check the workflow run for details."
```
